rounds.text: Sar Televenture Ltd is experiencing extraordinary top- and bottom-line expansion that vastly outpaces its industry peers, demonstrated by a compounded sales growth of 164% over 5 years and an astonishing 226% over the trailing twelve months [E8, E10], alongside a sector median sales growth of just 17.2% [E65]. This hyper-growth translates directly into immense cash generation, highlighted by an operating cash flow of Rs 123 Cr in March 2026, which represents a phenomenal 10.25x cash conversion against reported profit and fully backs earnings with hard cash [E21, E22, E24]. Furthermore, the company is almost debt-free with borrowings at Rs 0 Cr [E27, E47], and its capital expenditure phase is fully completed as indicated by CWIP dropping to Rs 0 Cr, signaling that new capacity is now coming online to drive future output [E28]. The market is severely mispricing this fundamental momentum by trading the stock at a cheap price-to-book ratio of 0.69x, with results scoring a high 85/100 while the price languishes near its 52-week low [E2, E5, E62]. Conceded: the stock suffers from a low return on equity of 1% [E15], declining operating margins [E20], and negative relative strength [E39].
